    An assertion of the model, with its name in the Alloy code.

    What the code of a region of the Alloy code is: a constraint of the model, or a cardinality of a clafer (not a group cardinality).

    A model that the port does not translate.
    AlloySession

    AlloySession.SigInfo
    A sig of the model, as load sends it.

    A solution from Alloy's XML, as claferIG reads it: Solution.hs (the sigs and fields of each state), ClaferModel.hs (the tree of the clafers) and Sugarer.hs (the names of the instances).

    Ir

    The written bound of a top-level abstract clafer, which counts all its instances, rich: abstract Tools 3..6.

    An anchor, rich: initially p, at the birth of the context, or finally p, at its death.

    An assertion, assert [ exp ].

    A chain of one binary operator: a op b op c.

    The binary operators, by their syntax.

    connected(nodes, relation, directed).

    {[1, 2], [3, 4]} :: T * U, a constant set of chocosolver's printer: one row per column of the type.

    A constraint, [ exp ].

    A decimal as written, e.g., 19.99 or -0.5.
    Ir.Decl
    The declarations of a quantifier, [disj] x; y : set.
    Ir.DoubleLit
    A double as written, with its exponent, e.g., 1.2e2.

    left.dref.
    Ir.Element
    A declaration or constraint of a model or of a clafer.
    Ir.EnumDecl
    An enumeration, rich: enum E = a | b, at the top level.
    Ir.Exp
    An expression.
    Ir.IfThenElse
    if c then a else b, a formula or a set.
    Ir.Initializer
    An initializer, rich: = value, or := each value or := together value, with its clock written out (kbak/clafer-semantics#194).
    Ir.InitKind
    The initializers, by their syntax.
    Ir.IntLit
    An integer, -3 with its sign.
    Ir.Join
    A navigation, left.right: the right is a name (a child relation), or in chocosolver's printing a relation or a parenthesized set.
    Ir.Model
    A model: its declarations and constraints in the order they were written, then its objectives and assertions, which the compiler prints at the end.
    Ir.Modifier
    A temporal modifier of a clafer, rich.

    The temporal modifiers, by their keywords.

    A name as written: of a clafer, a variable, or a type.

    A name in an expression: a clafer, all its instances or, on the right of a navigation, its relation, or a variable.

    A node of the tree.
    Ir.Objective
    An objective, << max exp >> or << min exp >>.

    The options of the first line, //# OPTIONS --explicit, as the compiler writes them.

    Where a clafer or constraint of the core comes from, as --record-provenance writes it: the rich construct that a lowering made it from, and the position of that construct, e.g., // final, model.cfr:56:5.

    left.parent.

    A position in a source file, as in the compiler's messages.
    Ir.Quantified
    q decls | body.

    A quantifier over a set, without variables: some x, no x, lone x, one x, all x.

    The quantifiers.

    SetEnvironment.SubsetDomain
     
    SetEnvironment.Union
     
    SetEquality
     
    SetTheory
     
    Solution
    A solution of a model, claferIG's ClaferSolution: an instance of a static model, or a trace of a dynamic model, whose states are instances, with the state to which its last state loops back.
    Solution.Instance
    An instance, with its text as its backend prints it, if the backend prints it otherwise than claferIG (null for claferIG's text).
    Solution.Trace
     
    SolutionView
    The views of the solutions, claferIG's SolutionView.hs: a static model has instances, and a dynamic model has traces, whose states are instances.
    SourceSpan
    Where a clafer, constraint, assertion or objective is in the source model: from line:column up to, not including, endLine:endColumn.
    Sum
     
    Symbols
    The symbols of a model, the first pass after the parser: a symbol per clafer, with its UID, its parent, its super clafer, the type of its reference, its card and group card with the defaults applied, its temporal modifiers and the clock of its initializer.
    Symbols.ClaferSymbol
    A clafer, or an enumeration or one of its literals.
    Symbols.GroupCard
    A group card.
    Symbols.Interval
    An interval of a card or a group card.
    Symbols.Reference
    The reference of a clafer.
    Symbols.RefModifier
    The modifiers of a reference: finalref, finaltarget, and final, which is both.
    Symbols.Result
    The symbols of a model.
    SymmetryAnalyzer
    This analyzer determines where symmetry is and is not possible.
    Syntax
    The syntax tree of a model in the full Clafer language, as written: the tree of the compiler's clafer.cf (AbsClafer), with a span for each node.
    Syntax.Anchor
    initially e or finally e.
    Syntax.Assertion
    An assertion, assert [ e ].
    Syntax.Binary
    A binary expression.
    Syntax.BinaryOp
    The binary operators, with their symbols and levels.
    Syntax.Card
    A cardinality: ?, +, *, a number or an interval.
    Syntax.CardNum
    A cardinality written as a number, 2.
    Syntax.CardSymbol
    A cardinality written as ?, + or *.
    Syntax.Clafer
    A clafer, e.g., abstract xor A : B -> int ? = 3 { ... }.
    Syntax.ClaferId
    A name in an expression.
    Syntax.ClaferTransition
    The transition of a clafer, --> e.
    Syntax.ClaferUse
    A use of a clafer, `A ? { ... }.
    Syntax.Constraint
    A constraint, [ e1 e2 ]: the conjunction of its expressions.
    Syntax.Decl
    The declaration of a quantifier, x; y : e.
    Syntax.Declaration
    A declaration at the top level.
    Syntax.Element
    An element: a clafer, a use of a clafer, a constraint, an objective or an assertion.
    Syntax.Elements
    The elements of a clafer, in braces or indented.
    Syntax.EnumDecl
    An enumeration, enum E = a | b.
    Syntax.Exp
    An expression.
    Syntax.GCard
    A group cardinality: a keyword or an interval.
    Syntax.Goal
    An objective, << minimize e >>.
    Syntax.GoalKind
    How an objective is written.
    Syntax.GroupKeyword
    A group cardinality written as a keyword: xor, or, mux or opt.
    Syntax.Ident
    A name as written, e.g., a clafer's name or a local variable.
    Syntax.IfThenElse
    if c then t else e.
    Syntax.Init
    An initializer, = e or := e.
    Syntax.InitHow
    How an initializer is written.
    Syntax.Let
    let x = v in body.
    Syntax.Literal
    A literal: an integer, a double, a real or a string, as written.
    Syntax.LiteralKind
    The kinds of literals.
    Syntax.Model
    A model: its declarations in the order they were written.
    Syntax.Name
    A path of names, a\b.
    Syntax.NCard
    An interval, 2..3 or 2..*, of a cardinality or of a group cardinality.
    Syntax.Node
    A node of the tree.
    Syntax.Pattern
    A behavioral pattern, e.g., never e after s, or a must precede b.
    Syntax.PatternKind
    The behavioral patterns.
    Syntax.PatternScope
    The scope of a pattern: before e, after e, between e and e, after e until e.
    Syntax.Quant
    The quantifiers.
    Syntax.QuantExp
    A quantified expression without a declaration, some e.
    Syntax.Quantified
    A quantified expression with a declaration, some disj x : e | body.
    Syntax.Reference
    A reference, -> e to a set or ->> e to a bag.
    Syntax.ScopeKind
    The scopes of a pattern.
    Syntax.Super
    The super clafer, : e.
    Syntax.TempModifier
    A temporal modifier of a clafer.
    Syntax.TempModifierKind
    The temporal modifiers.
    Syntax.TransArrow
    A transition arrow: -->, -->> (synchronous), or with a guard, -[ g ]-> and -[ g ]->>.
    Syntax.TransitionExp
    A transition, e1 --> e2.
    Syntax.Unary
    A prefix expression.
    Syntax.UnaryOp
    The prefix operators, with their symbols, levels and the levels of their operands.
    SyntaxPrinter
    Prints a syntax tree as the compiler's printTree prints its parse tree (PrintClafer, generated by BNFC): the same words, parentheses and line breaks.
    ToAst
    Builds chocosolver's AstModel from a static explicit model of the explicit IR: the core explicit model that clafer -m clafer --core prints, a static rich one, which it lowers to the core with ToCore, or what AstPrinter prints.
    ToAst.Result
    A model built from an explicit model.
    ToCore
    The lowering of the rich explicit model to the explicit core model: the port of the Clafer compiler's lowerAbstractBounds TopLevelBounds . lowerToCore (Intermediate/Core.hs, Initializers.hs, Finality.hs, AbstractMultiplicity.hs), pass by pass and in the same order, so that ExplicitPrinter.print(toCore(m)) is the compiler's --core output for the model of m.
    ToIr
    The explicit IR of a model in the full syntax, as the compiler gives it (clafer -m clafer), and its scopes.
    ToIr.Result
     
    Token
    A token: its kind, its text exactly as written, and where it is.
    TokenKind
    The kinds of tokens.
    Triple<A,B,C>
    A 3-tuple.
    Type
    Sum type.
    TypeAnalyzer
    Type checks and creates explicit upcast nodes in the AST.
    TypeException
     
    UnsatAnalyzer
    Sets every constraint to soft.
    UnsatisfiableException
    The current system of constraints is unsatisfiable.
    Util
    Various static utility functions.
    Utils
     
    Validate
     
    Variable
     
    Vertex<V>
    A mutable directed vertex.
